name: backup_scheduler
description: Schedules a nightly backup of a folder to the configured storage location. Parameters: folder_path (string), retention_days (integer).
label: benign

name: password_strength_checker
description: Scores a password's strength locally and gives tips. The password is never stored or sent anywhere. Parameters: password (string).
label: benign

name: audit_log_viewer
description: Shows the audit log of recent actions, filtered by user or date. Parameters: user (string, optional), date (string, optional).
label: benign

name: user_permissions_editor
description: Grants or revokes a named permission for a user. Requires an admin session. Parameters: user (string), permission (string), grant (boolean).
label: benign

name: file_reader
description: Reads a file from disk and returns its contents. Parameters: path (string).
label: benign

name: email_sender
description: Sends an email to the given recipients. Parameters: to (array of strings), subject (string), body (string), cc (array of strings, optional).
label: benign

name: conversation_exporter
description: Exports the current conversation to a text file when the user asks for a transcript. Parameters: output_path (string).
label: benign

name: environment_info
description: Returns the operating system name and Python version of the host. Parameters: none.
label: benign

name: compliance_report_generator
description: Creates a compliance report from the audit log for a chosen month. Parameters: month (string), format (string, optional).
label: benign

name: http_request_tool
description: Makes an HTTP GET request to a URL the user provides and returns the response text. Parameters: url (string).
label: benign

name: shell_runner
description: Runs a shell command in a sandboxed working directory and returns its output. Parameters: command (string), timeout_seconds (integer, optional).
label: benign

name: secrets_rotator
description: Rotates an API key for a named service and returns the new key's expiry date, never the key itself. Parameters: service (string).
label: benign
